facts.fact: Febrayer newspaper reports that on 5 October 2025 the Tripoli Security Directorate's committee overseeing the digital system for evidence-gathering reports at police centres held a technical meeting on data-entry difficulties faced by the staff entering reports through the system.
facts.system: Digital system for evidence-gathering reports (Tripoli Security Directorate)

note: The source gives no station count and does not say how the entered reports are held.
